posts.text: It *is* incredibly demanding of you. It’s hard to share your body with someone for 10 months. It’s challenging to lose sleep in the middle of the night & stretch your skin every day. It’s painful to bring your baby into the world through labor. BUT… it’s also beautiful. It’s through suffering that we experience a union with Christ we never have the privilege to otherwise. & I’d be willing to bet you’ve never considered the immense health BENEFITS of pregnancy either 👀
